art_revision: F1.1 — Stable coach, draft horse and paddock foreground fence are independent JSON assets/world objects.
notes:
F1.0 completes the mage breakfast reward and Act One finale; Outside Gate and Stables connect west/east; all previous art/world data is retained except the rebuilt Stables background.
SGGF1.1: the carriage, new dark-bay draft horse and foreground paddock fence are independent world objects backed by separate Luma JSON recipes. Stables geometry and Kitty recipes remain unchanged from F1.0.
SGGF1.3: removed the temporary Castle Path threshold guide stroke, added a visible Castle Exterior direction arrow beyond the unchanged invisible crossing threshold, and moved the Castle Exterior return landing safely onto the Castle Path approach. All other F1.2 assets, areas, gameplay, and transition logic are retained.
